description: Say how a transfer is going: its state, how many bytes are done, the speed, the route (direct, or through our servers), and, once it has ended, how it ended in a fixed word and a plain sentence. Give wait_seconds to wait for it to end (for up to that long) instead of asking again and again. Without a transfer_id it lists every transfer this server has run.

saved_from.description: For a transfer that saves files: list the saved files from this number on (the list shows up to 100 at a time; saved_more says how many are left). Default 0.

transfer_id.description: The transfer_id that send_files or receive_files returned. Leave it out to list them all.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the transfer to end. Default 0: answer at once.

name: transfer_status
title: Check a transfer
